irrigation_schedule_latency.definition: schedule_generated_at minus input_packet_received_at per forecast cycle

water_stress_forecast_mae.definition: mean absolute error between predicted soil moisture and probe reading

nitrogen_recommendation_error.definition: mean absolute error between DSS recommendation and agronomist reference prescription

data_continuity_uptime.definition: 15-minute sensor packets processed within 30 minutes divided by total received packets

network_usage.definition: bytes sent and received per service and architecture mode, normalized to MB/hour where a window exists

compute_usage.definition: measured CPU/GPU hours where available, otherwise duration multiplied by utilization ratio

sources.assumption: device power draw multiplied by processing duration

energy_usage.definition: kWh for forecast processing/transmission and farming operations when meter or estimate data exists

standards_interoperability_switchability.definition: auditable evidence for standards, interfaces, module replaceability, and hardware reuse
